title: SAFETIM-needs : Exploring Adolescent's and Parent's Needs During Transition in French CF Centers
brief_summary: prospective multicentric study protocol in french CF center, exploring adolescent avec parents needs during transition from pediatric CF center to adult CF center
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* CF adolescent and their parents , for whom the transition to the adult center is scheduled within six months and witch have freely agreed to participate in the interviews

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: CF adolescent and their parents , for whom the transition to the adult center is scheduled within six months and witch have freely agreed to participate in the interviews their age will be between 17 and 23 years old. living followed in one of the 3 CF center
